title: Kie Senpai releases a beautiful new single, "Missing."
htmlContent:
"Missing" is a new single from Kie Senpai. Followed by his previous release "Classico," which has received recognition from different outlets for an outstanding job.

The single "Missing" features a unique flow, and heartfelt lyrics are pretty engaging. The new single was written for times of reflection on a long-distance relationship and how one misses their partner in the long run. He runs through the bad patches and his journey to recovery and finding inner peace. It includes a relatable narrative and ear-pleasing vocals that will resonate well with fans. Follow Kie Senpai on all social media.
